title: AuditLogEventList
description: A cursor-paginated page of Audit log events

data.description: The page of Audit log events (at most `limit` items)

timestamp.description: When the change occurred (ISO 8601, UTC, millisecond precision)

actor_email.description: Email of the user who made the change, or the owner of a dashboard-created Platform API key. Empty for system and service-token actors.

actor_name.description: Display name of the actor; empty when unavailable

actor_user_id.description: User id of the actor. For an API key, the id of the user who created the key. Empty for system and service-token actors.

entity_type.description: The type of entity that was changed

entity_id.description: The id of the entity that was changed

entity_name.description: A human-readable name for the changed entity

activity.description: What happened to the entity. One of `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `executed`, `invited`, `activated`, or `deactivated`.

interface.description: Where the change originated, such as `dashboard`, `api`, `mcp`, `cli`, `import`, `export`, or `system` (background jobs and Ada's internal processing).

context_ip.description: Source IP address of the request that made the change

context_user_agent.description: User agent string of the request that made the change

api_key_name.description: Name of the API key used, when the change was made by a dashboard-created Platform API key; empty otherwise.

AuditLogEvent.description: A single Audit log event: one configuration change recorded for the account. Empty-string fields mean the value was unavailable for that event (for example, a system actor has no email).
AuditLogEvent.title: AuditLogEvent

next_page_url.description: URL for the next page of results, or `null` on the last or empty page. Replay it unchanged to keep the time window and the cursor constant across pages.
